## Problem and result
Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior (or the artifact delivered).

## Linked work
Refs #
Use `Closes #...` only when this PR satisfies the complete issue.

## Validation
Describe checks actually run, results and evidence. For planning/documentation, describe the review rather than inventing software tests.

## Acceptance checklist
- [ ] Applicable issue acceptance criteria are met and evidence is linked.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus and screen-reader behavior checked where applicable.
- [ ] Reset, teardown, reading position and unsupported-page behavior checked where applicable.
- [ ] Privacy, permissions and secrets reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] User/developer documentation and limitations updated.
- [ ] Shared API/style/preference changes have the agreed cross-company review.

## Limitations and follow-up
List remaining concerns, intentional deferrals and linked issues. Mark genuinely inapplicable checks with an explanation.
